arStrings.szText:
Your {c_important}Witchcraft{/c} Powers deal an additional {c_random}[SF_3*100|%|]{/c} of their damage over {c_number}{SF_5}{/c} seconds. This damage is dealt as Bleeding, Burning, Poisoning, or Shadow Damage Over Time depending on your class.{if:SF_2}

If your damage over time effects exceed {c_number}[SF_6*100]%{/c} of a target's total Life, that target is executed.{/if}
Unlocked at Coven's Favor Tier V and purchased from an Altar of Witchcraft at the Tree of Whispers.
If your damage over time effects exceed {c_number}[SF_6*100]%{/c} of a target's total Life, that target is executed.
